facts: Wind of 6 kts, with small waves
In the second beat of race 2, CRO 1405 was sailing on starboard tack and CHN 5011 was sailing on port tack.

When the bow of CRO 1405 was 0.5 metres from the middle of the starboard side of CHN 5011, CRO 1405 bore away sharply and passed astern of CHN 5011. CHN 5011 luffed briefly and then bore away back to a close-hauled course.
There was no contact and no boat took a penalty.
conclusions: CHN 5011 on port tack failed to keep clear of CRO 1405 sailing on starboard tack, breaking rule 10.
